verdict.rationale: Enterprise authentication such as SSO, SAML, or cloud-platform identity is a fair question for a SaaS code-review product, but the evidence pack never documents it. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: role-based access control for subscription settings (cubic-docs-47) and connecting ChatGPT or Claude subscriptions to supply models for local reviews (cubic-docs-14).

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
